title: 2390. Removing Stars From a String

examples.explanation: Performing the removals from left to right: - The closest character to the 1st star is 't' in "leet**cod*e". s becomes "lee*cod*e". - The closest character to the 2nd star is 'e' in "lee*cod*e". s becomes "lecod*e". - The closest character to the 3rd star is 'd' in "lecod*e". s becomes "lecoe". There are no more stars, so we return "lecoe".
The entire string is removed, so we return an empty string.
